Fig. 6. SNN vs. ADA Rule vs. Bi-LSTM vs. MLP — Complete Comparison. Panel A: Overall accuracy and HIGH-class recall (safety metric) for all four classifiers on the 5,724-window test set. ADA Rule’s 100% HIGH recall is a circular evaluation artefact. Panel B: Estimated energy per inference on neuromorphic hardware (log scale). The SNN is 79,267× more energy efficient than the Bi-LSTM. Energy computed using SynOps (SNN) vs. MAC operations (LSTM/MLP) following Merolla et al. [15] and Diehl et al. [16].
